The '''Alliga system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Phelleem sector/Legends|Phelleem sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alliga]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Holwuff/Legends|Holwuff]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
